description: This Python script is a test suite for validating Jira Dashboard API endpoints. It includes methods to perform health checks, authentication, fetch projects, and retrieve project details, along with functions to run basic and full tests. The script can be executed with command-line arguments to run appropriate tests.

classes.name: JiraAPITester
classes.description: A class encapsulating methods to test various Jira API endpoints, including health, authentication, project list, and project details.

methods.name: JiraAPITester.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the tester with a base URL and creates a session.

methods.name: JiraAPITester.test_health_check
methods.description: Performs a health check GET request to the root endpoint.

methods.name: JiraAPITester.test_authentication
methods.description: Tests Jira API login using provided credentials.

methods.name: JiraAPITester.test_fetch_projects
methods.description: Fetches the list of projects from Jira.

methods.name: JiraAPITester.test_project_details
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific project.

methods.name: JiraAPITester.run_basic_tests
methods.description: Runs health check as a basic test without requiring credentials.

methods.name: JiraAPITester.run_full_tests
methods.description: Runs a suite of tests including health, authentication, project fetch, and optional project details with credentials.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main entry point that parses command-line arguments and executes test routines accordingly.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] run_full_tests(self, email: str, api_token: str, domain: str, project_key: str = None)
Dict[str,Any] test_authentication(self, email: str, api_token: str, domain: str)
Dict[str,Any] test_fetch_projects(self, email: str, api_token: str, domain: str)
Dict[str,Any] test_project_details(self, project_key: str, email: str, api_token: str, domain: str)

ctags.name: run_full_tests
ctags.pattern: /^    def run_full_tests(self, email: str, api_token: str, domain: str, project_key: str = None) -/
ctags.signature: (self, email: str, api_token: str, domain: str, project_key: str = None)

ctags.name: test_authentication
ctags.pattern: /^    def test_authentication(self, email: str, api_token: str, domain: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/
ctags.signature: (self, email: str, api_token: str, domain: str)

ctags.name: test_fetch_projects
ctags.pattern: /^    def test_fetch_projects(self, email: str, api_token: str, domain: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/
ctags.signature: (self, email: str, api_token: str, domain: str)

ctags.name: test_project_details
ctags.pattern: /^    def test_project_details(self, project_key: str, email: str, api_token: str, domain: str) ->/
ctags.signature: (self, project_key: str, email: str, api_token: str, domain: str)
